description: Extrudes a sketch's closed profile along the sketch's normal, optionally in a second direction too and as a thin wall: a boss adds material, a cut removes it. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. Checked: the feature exists with its type, rebuilds without error, and the part's volume grew (boss) or shrank (cut); for a blind or mid-plane boss (blind both ways with direction2) without draft or thin wall on a part with no body yet, the volume is exactly the profile's area times the total depth. Otherwise the feature is deleted and the part is as it was (rolled back); the sketch stays. Busy with user_editing while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

sketch.description: The sketch to extrude: its name (Sketch3) or its reference. Its closed loops are the profile.

mode.description: boss (adds material) or cut (removes it). Default boss.

end.description: blind (depth_mm along the normal), mid_plane (depth_mm in total, half each side), through_all, up_to_next, up_to_vertex or up_to_surface (both name up_to). Default blind.

depth_mm.description: How far, mm, for blind and mid_plane; more than 0. Not given for the other ends.

up_to.description: For up_to_vertex, a vertex or point; for up_to_surface, a face or plane: its reference or name.

reverse.description: Extrude the other way, against the sketch's normal. Not with mid_plane. Default false.

draft_deg.description: A draft angle, degrees, more than 0 and less than 90; no draft when absent.

draft_outward.description: The draft widens the profile as it goes instead of narrowing it. Default false.

merge.description: For a boss: merge it with the bodies it touches. Default true. Not for a cut.

end.description: blind (depth_mm), through_all, up_to_next, up_to_vertex or up_to_surface (both name up_to). Default blind. Not mid_plane.

depth_mm.description: How far, mm, for blind; more than 0. Not given for the other ends.

up_to.description: For up_to_vertex, a vertex or point; for up_to_surface, a face or plane: its reference or name.

draft_deg.description: A draft angle for this direction, degrees, more than 0 and less than 90; no draft when absent.

direction2.description: Extrude the other way from the sketch plane as well, with its own end. Not with mid_plane.

thickness_mm.description: The wall's thickness, mm, more than 0.

side.description: one_side (the default), other_side, mid_plane (half each side of the outline) or two_sides (thickness_mm on one side, thickness2_mm on the other).

thickness2_mm.description: For two_sides: the thickness on the other side, mm, more than 0.

thin.description: Make a thin wall from the profile's outline instead of filling it.
